text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While making preparations for the year-end 
"Dream Fest"... there was something we had 
to consider.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The production of a promotional movie 
starring Sirius Symboli has been decided, 
but...
choice_data_list:
(I'd like to do some other promotions 
too.)

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that your activities on 
the network played a major role in 
promoting the race.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"If that is the case, convey your feelings 
until the very end. I will prepare 
anything and everything you need."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this momentum, I'd like to 
brainstorm more promotional ideas for the 
"Dream Fest"— and by extension, the 
Twinkle Series.
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should talk to someone about 
this...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The face that suddenly came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre radiates a brilliant, intense 
light... Before I knew it, my feet had 
carried me to wherever she might be.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Did I give an order?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I am asking if I commanded you to do so. 
To go and slack off, that is.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Did I ever order you... to abandon your 
duties and rush to my side?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Is what Orfevre talking about the 
promotional work? Telling them not to 
neglect their own duties...
choice_data_list:
I'm a bit lost on what direction to 
take...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hesitate? Over what?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are you saying you cannot see it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —My majesty is...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Make haste and arrange it. Then, spread 
the word.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What transpired on this occasion was truly 
insolent... Nay, thoroughly disgraceful.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So that even the ignorant masses can 
understand... I shall demonstrate it once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
As long as Orfevre is here— the Twinkle 
Series is in safe hands.

text_block_list.name: High Schooler A
text_block_list.text:
—I mean, aren't we kinda bored? Isn't 
there anything fun to do?

text_block_list.name: High Schooler A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up? You look totally 
entranced... Is that a Twinkle Series 
poster?

text_block_list.name: High Schooler B
text_block_list.text: "...Crap... I gotta get to the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: High Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
I want to meet this girl... ...Lady... 
Orfèvre—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"What came to mind was Mejiro Ramonu... A 
girl of few words, but whose face 
unmistakably showed her love for racing."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. Very much so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Yet everything exists... for the sake of 
racing."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You don't know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm nurturing it. Slowly and carefully... 
for "that day."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's phrasing is difficult to 
parse. Even so, there is something deeply 
captivating about the way she carries 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked how we should promote "Dream 
Fest"...――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Inviting them to the racecourse is your 
duty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
By any means necessary, casting all pride 
aside... Please, do your absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: All that remains is already decided.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Just run... And that'll be the end of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I can no longer— be parted from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I'm looking forward to it...
choice_data_list: (…Maybe I'm about to do something crazy…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Like a pure fan being charmed by a 
demon... Perhaps I'm about to do something 
terrible. The thought sent shivers down my 
spine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna... It feels like she would 
give advice that cuts right to the heart 
of the matter.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is advice alone... really enough?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My family possesses considerable influence 
across various industries.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If we're thinking about promotion, I 
believe it would be foolish not to take 
advantage of it."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I cannot fathom any reason for you to 
hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly intend to change 
everything... do you really have the 
luxury to be picky about your methods?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It is "power." That alone is what moves 
the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, if that is what you seek... you 
must demonstrate a strength befitting it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we could enlist her family's help, we 
could certainly reach a wider audience 
with our publicity. But...
choice_data_list: ...No, I'll think about it a little more.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, getting cold feet?
choice_data_list:
This time, I want a power I can handle 
with my own hands

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The academy and the URA must have already 
handled the groundwork behind the scenes. 
What's required of me as her Trainer is 
surely—
choice_data_list:
Because it's about reaching every single 
fan.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to Gentildonna's suggestion 
helped me settle on my course of action. I 
express my gratitude and start to leave, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to ask once more. —Is advice 
truly all you require?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How you "handle" your Umamusume is 
entirely in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Over there... is that...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"G-Gentildonna?! Why are you in a place 
like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Do you all like power? An overwhelming 
victory? One-sided devastation?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The strong deserve a standing ovation. 
Everyone, please invite your friends and 
come on down to the racetrack."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy this thrilling, 
flesh-and-blood contest to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli was slated to appear in a 
promotion... Come to think of it, why did 
she accept?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was there also a sense of obligation to 
her relative, Speed Symboli? When I asked 
her—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Does it really look to you like I'm just 
rejecting everything and rebelling for no 
reason?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you wouldn't even have that 
question in the first place.
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Hah. Don't look so frightened.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pretty boring, ain't it? With a half-assed 
crowd like this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is the arena... where I 
shall prove my strength.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta give the peanut gallery 
something to get hyped about, at least, 
right?
choice_data_list:
So you're saying you'll do the promotion 
if it's for that...?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Naturally, there are conditions.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that satisfied it. And on top of 
that—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Speed Symboli didn't ask "that guy," she 
came begging to me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If I don't answer both of 'em, wouldn't 
that be a shame for either side?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli seems quite amused. It 
appears this situation unfolded just the 
way she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Come on, don't look so worried.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Disciplining clueless little puppies 
happens to be my specialty, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to those words, even during the 
promotional video shoot held at a later 
date—

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
—...S-So cool... Maybe I should go cheer 
at her race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Sirius Symboli made me certain that 
once it was released to the public, it 
would definitely capture everyone's 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon is always proactive when it 
comes to promotional activities. Wanting 
to hear her thoughts, I went looking for 
her, and—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Helloooo! Helloooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna hold a race called the 'Dream 
Fest' soon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's a super exciting festival! Please 
come check it out, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, this race...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ! You know it?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Uh, ah... Well, yeah. Things have really 
been heating up lately, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Though, I don't really get what's so great 
about sports, so... um...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Then in that case! Could you give me 
three minutes of your time?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The rules of racing are simple! You 
compete against each other, and whoever 
crosses the finish line first wins!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: ...What was so amusing about that—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Still! The one who wins isn't the only 
'main character'!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, you're curious, right? About 
what it all means... right!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure you'll understand completely 
once you watch the upcoming race!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I know something will stay in your heart! 
Just believe in Falco and give me some of 
your time!"

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks for the flyer. ...See you at 
the racetrack, then."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yes! See you laterー☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Hey there, miss! Care to watch a 
race?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Appealing to people's hearts steadily and 
directly... I learned that even if it 
seems like the long way around, in the 
end, that's what truly captures their 
hearts the most.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, the ones who came to mind were 
the girls who gave their all for the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I tried reaching out to them, it 
turned out all three were at the 
racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun! Over here.
choice_data_list: There are no races today, right?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But... all three of our hearts won't 
stop pounding.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"It's been so very long since I last ran 
in a race!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like immersing myself in the 
atmosphere of the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I never dreamed it in my wildest 
imagination. That I would stand upon the 
turf once more.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
I need to slim down a bit more, don't I? 
So I can stand alongside my beloved 
children.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Let's give it a shot! It's me, after all, 
so it will be quite all right."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Fufu! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Has Speed Symboli-san been gaining 
weight?"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"No... I am being reminded once again that 
eating is also part of training."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
However, I will definitely achieve my 
goal. After all, this is a race.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~! That's right, that's totally right!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wonder what kind of scenery awaits 
us. Will it be the same as back then, or 
different...? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
They talked happily together. Watching 
them, there was an innocent simplicity 
reminiscent of the students at the 
academy—
choice_data_list:
Everyone... you really love racing, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Of course! Yes! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's right, it was.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: St. Lite, Haiseiko, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Pardon us, Trainer. You needed something 
from us, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I love racing. Because I realized that as 
long as I put my heart into it... I can 
captivate their souls.

text_block_list.text:
—Naturally, the ones who came to mind were 
the girls who gave their all for the 
Twinkle Series.
